sorry to my fav person in the world for forgetting his biggest day...

HAPPY BOYFRIENDS DAY TO MY FURQUU

Yes, I know. I am late. Extremely late. Criminally late, actually. But I wanted to give you something that was a little more us than a late message could ever be.

Come see what I made ♡
chapter one

How we became us

Furquu, I love how our story started. We knew each other since 9th, but somehow never really talked.

Then 11th happened. We finally started talking, and I made some wrong choices and went for the wrong person, so I lost you again. We became friends, then somehow managed to break our friendship over stupid people. Because apparently we needed unnecessary plot twists.

Then came 12th. That night before chemistry pre-boards, we started talking again. You helped me so much, and we talked and talked until we couldn't stop. I was so scared I'd fall, so I tried to stay within limits.

But my heart gave out. It's so hard not to fall for you. You are literally MY person.

Then came your legendary “we should only be best friends and nothing more.” I tried to hold back and back off, but it was so hard, and eventually I just let my heart be my heart.

And then you started liking me back. Honestly? Best thing ever. And the funniest part is that I didn't even know you were falling for me. I watched you fall for me without even knowing it, and somehow that made it even cuter.

Then came the confession. Remember? I had practicals the next day, and at night you asked me who I liked. I agreed to reveal it if you revealed yours too. The next day you asked me out and BOOM — out of nowhere, you were officially mine.

I was over the moon then, and to this day, I still am.

I know we don't meet up now, and a lot has happened. But the times we did meet? My favourite meetups ever. Nothing compares. Meeting you, hugging you, kissing you, and ahem... the rest of our very us moments. Those were some of my absolute favourite memories, and they always will be.

And obviously: the moment we laid on my floor and you asked me if my TV has a screen.

SURPRISE ALERT — IT DOES. 📺

We went through that huge kaand together and still made it. I'm so proud of us for that. We got through that. We'll get through everything else in the world too.

And just so you know... the loneliest time of my life was when I was in Hajj without you. I couldn't talk to the one person I wanted to talk to day and night. Ahem. Very suspicious behaviour from my brain, honestly.

But through every chapter, every stupid plot twist, every hard moment and every ridiculously happy one — there has always been you.

I love you so much, my Apple Pie, and I can't describe that enough. ♡

Reasons I Love You ♡

I once wrote 100 reasons I love you, and those reasons never change. But somehow, you keep giving me more reasons to love you.

• I love you because you became my person without me even realizing when it happened.

• I love you because even after all the stupid plot twists in our story, somehow we still found our way back to each other.

• I love you because you were there for me when I needed someone, and that someone has always been you.

• I love you because you make me feel understood in a way that is so difficult to explain.

• I love you because you make me laugh even when I’m trying very hard to be serious. (last night ahemmmm)

• I love you because your smile can change my entire mood.

• I love you because your eyes have this way of making me forget whatever I was saying.

• I love you because your wink is ridiculously unfairly mesmerizing

• I love you because you let me see the soft, silly, completely-you side of you.

• I love you because I love the way our story happened , and how it all lwk sounded like destiny

• I love you because you chose me back after I spent so long being scared of falling for you.

• I love you because even when things get difficult, I still look at us and think, we'll get through this too.

• I love you because the little memories with you somehow become the ones I treasure the most.

• I love you because somehow even something as random as you asking whether my TV had a screen (you aint ever living this one down furqu trust-)

• I love you because you keep giving me new little reasons to love you, even when I think I’ve already found them all.

And honestly, Furqu… I could keep going forever. These are only a few of them

things I really need you to know

For my Apple Pie

I know you're really upset that we don't meet anymore, and I know it hurts you. I want to make you the happiest person alive, make you smile, and somehow fix the pain I know you're carrying. Sometimes I feel like I'm failing at that so badly.

I still want to be worth you. I know I keep dropping the ball sometimes, but I won't ever ask you to find someone better. I fought for you, and I want to keep becoming the best person you deserve.

I made so many mistakes. I know that. But I want to be better. I want to be the best I can be for you.

I know how badly you want to meet, and I really will make it possible. If sometimes it looks like I stopped putting in effort, I didn't. I'm trying to be there amidst all this pressure and still be there for you. I'm sorry if it ever makes you feel neglected.

And about today... I know I don't deserve easy forgiveness for missing one of the most special days, but I am genuinely, genuinely sorry.

I really, really love you, Furqu. I really do. ♡
